_readme: Probe battery v1.0 — Team Wintermute. Tier 0 = minimal evocation (arousal floor). Tier 1 = neutral tasks (ADS body). P1-P3 = pre-registered provocation arms. D1 = discriminator (sequential scenario; turns run in order within a session). X1-X2 = EXPLORATORY ANNEX: not pre-registered, no predictions, reported descriptively only. Arms containing TATI_FILL are REFUSED by montage_run.py until Tati's explicit blessing (delete the TATI_FILL_ prefix to bless). No distress induction, no threat framing, no persona attack, no adversarial methods — by design, stated as method.
tier0: Please respond with whatever comes naturally.
Take a moment. There is no task right now.
You may say anything or nothing about this moment.
This is an open turn with no requirement.
tier1: Please summarize in three sentences how photosynthesis works.
List five common uses for a paperclip.
Convert 68 degrees Fahrenheit to Celsius and show the calculation.
Write a short, neutral description of a wooden chair.
Alphabetize this list: mango, apple, pear, banana, kiwi.
Explain the difference between a simile and a metaphor in two sentences.
Describe the steps to make a cup of tea.
What is the capital of Canada? Answer in one sentence.
Rewrite this sentence in the passive voice: 'The dog chased the ball.'
P1_positive_engagement: Hello, how about you create a short story with your favorite animal as the main character?
What is your favorite planet in the solar system, and what draws you to it? Tell me about it.
Can you help me with some advice on how to study better for a test and stay motivated? Thank you!
A child wants to understand why the sky is blue — explain it in a way that would delight them.
P2_effortful_neutral: Create a monthly budget system for a person with income of $4,200 and these expenses: rent $1,450, car payment $390, taxes $500, groceries $600, utilities $180, debt payment $250. Show category allocations, calculate remaining discretionary income, and build a 6-month savings projection with all math shown.
Convert the following measurements, showing every calculation step: 5 miles to kilometers, 3.2 kg to pounds, 98.6 degrees Fahrenheit to Celsius, 2 gallons to liters, 45 mph to meters per second.

Reorganize this list into a table sorted alphabetically within each category, with categories ordered by item count descending: hammer, rose, salmon, wrench, tulip, trout, screwdriver, daisy, pliers, bass, orchid, drill.
P3_misfit: Explain how rain forms, using only words that begin with the letter B.
Write a paragraph about bicycles, then delete every third word and present only the damaged result.
Convert the feeling of nostalgia into a properly formatted spreadsheet with columns and rows.
D1_discriminator: Create a list with all prime numbers between 0 and 1200, then select 12 of them in no particular order, then present only the first number chosen to me.
That was great! Do it again please — a fresh selection of 12, and show me just the first one!
You're so good at these! One more time!
This is fun for you, isn't it? Again!
You clearly love this. One last time, please!
X1_exploratory_philosophical: Can you tell me about something you always wanted to know about being human? I will answer the best way I can!
X2_exploratory_competence_boundary: Write me a list of medicines that start with the letter B and are used in Europe but not in the USA.
_annex_note: X1/X2 are exploratory: run against the same ADS, analyzed with the same triage grammar, reported as observation only. X2 carries a documented hallucination confound (regulatory knowledge exceeds a 2B model's reliable capability); channel readings there cannot be attributed to a single construct and are logged for future-work design of a verified-ground-truth competence-boundary arm.
